description: This is a PHP source file defining a controller class 'ChannelProgramAdminController' within the Goteo project. The class manages administrative actions such as listing, adding, and editing channel programs, including routing configurations and form processing.

classes.name: ChannelProgramAdminController
classes.description: Controller class for administrative management of channel programs, including routing, listing, creation, and editing functionalities.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group name 'channels' for organizational purposes.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Defines the HTTP routes associated with this controller, mapping URLs to actions.
